study: TUM freiburg1_xyz existing ECHO AB-V2-final; scene-level sources, no furniture identified
created_by: GPT D evidence ledger derived from immutable original ECHO machine reports before first furniture Hi3D comparison
recorded_date_source: TUM original image/depth timestamps from filenames (UNIX seconds), not re-encoded test MP4 timebase

source_archive.license: TUM RGB-D paper describes CC BY 3.0; verify attribution and redistributions with official source

pose_provenance.reference: TUM mocap groundtruth (original raw trajectory) for independent reference; dynamic camera poses obtained from dataset text, not guaranteed each RGB timestamp without interpolation
pose_provenance.estimated: COLMAP RGB-only poses in ECHO report, not measured
pose_provenance.geometry: ECHO A/B meshes are whole scenes, NOT segmented furniture

sensor_depth.already_metric_output_rule: raw PNG / 5000 once; do not divide already-meter-valued depth again
sensor_depth.calibration_quality: RGB/depth time difference frozen from ECHO run, not a guarantee of zero registration error

preregistered_protocol.name: AB-V2-final
preregistered_protocol.reference_split_origin: Issue #28 prior to any Hi3D results
preregistered_protocol.identity_rule: MUST NOT change splits after candidate appears; holdout NEVER used for fitting geometry, registration, scale or object selection
